title: Fibrosis on PSV with high ETS: premature cycling and double triggers
summary: A short time constant (stiff lung) makes inspiratory flow decay quickly; with ETS 60% the ventilator cycles off long before the neural Ti ends. The continuing effort notches early expiratory flow and often re-triggers a second breath.
objectives: Recognize early cycling: abrupt end of a short breath, expiratory flow that returns toward zero, then a second trigger.
Fix by lowering ETS toward 5–10% (or a set Ti) so the breath lasts as long as the effort.

fix.note: ETS 5%, PS 10, PEEP 6: the breath now spans the neural Ti.
